entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, I want to return something. I'm not happy with it.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little while ago and it's just not working out for me.
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchase. Could you tell me why you'd like to return it?

It doesn't track my sleep properly and the heart rate monitor is all over the place. Seriously, I wore it for a run yesterday and it said my pulse was 220! I'm not an Olympian. This smart watch is junk.

I apologize that you're having issues with the VeloBand Pulse. I understand your frustration. Let's get this return processed for you. I just need to confirm the purchase date to ensure it is within our return policy.

Okay, I see the purchase date. Our standard return policy is 90 days for most items. Since you are well within that timeframe, we can absolutely process a full refund. I am so sorry you were not satisfied with the smart watch.
90 days? Are you sure? I thought I saw something about a shorter window when I was buying it.

Yes, absolutely. Our standard return policy gives you 90 days to return an item for a full refund, no questions asked. Some exceptions may apply, but not in this case. Let me go ahead and generate a return shipping label for you. I'll send it to the email address on file.
Okay, great. How long will it take to get the refund?
Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse, we'll process the refund immediately. You should see the funds back in your account within 5-7 business days.
Fantastic. Thanks for your help. I was really worried I was stuck with this thing.
You're very welcome! I'm happy we could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Have a great day!
